description:
The Death Benefit scheme under the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (GBOCWWB) was launched to provide financial assistance to the families of construction workers who have died while engaged in their work.

This scheme was introduced to ensure that the dependents of deceased construction workers receive timely financial support during their time of grief and need.

The GBOCWWB scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on families who lose their primary breadwinners in the construction sector.

The specific objective of the Death Benefit scheme is to provide a one-time financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 to the family of the deceased worker.

This assistance is intended to help cover immediate expenses related to the death, such as funeral costs and other financial obligations.

The scheme is applicable to construction workers registered under the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 2002.

To be eligible for the Death Benefit, the construction worker must have been registered with the GBOCWWB at the time of their death.

The worker must also have contributed to the welfare fund for a minimum period of 12 months prior to their death.

The applicant for the Death Benefit must be a legal heir or dependent of the deceased construction worker.

Eligible dependents include the spouse, children, or parents of the deceased worker.

The application process for the Death Benefit involves several steps that must be followed to ensure a smooth and efficient disbursement of funds.

First, the applicant must obtain the death certificate of the deceased construction worker from the local municipal authority.

Next, the applicant must fill out the prescribed application form available at the GBOCWWB office or on their official website.

The application form must be accompanied by several documents including the death certificate, proof of relationship to the deceased, and the worker's registration details.

The applicant must also provide a copy of their own identity proof and address proof.

Once the application form and documents are ready, the applicant must submit them to the nearest GBOCWWB office.

The application will be reviewed by the designated officer at the GBOCWWB.

The processing of the application typically takes about 30 days from the date of submission.

If the application is approved, the financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the eligible dependent.

The disbursement is made through electronic transfer to ensure timely and secure delivery of funds.

The GBOCWWB has established a dedicated helpline for queries related to the Death Benefit scheme.

The contact number for the GBOCWWB helpline is +91-832-243-8000.

The office of the GBOCWWB is located at the Labour Department, Government of Goa, Panaji.

The scheme is part of a larger initiative by the Government of Goa to improve the welfare of construction workers in the state.

As of October 2023, the GBOCWWB has reported that over 10,000 construction workers are registered under the scheme.

The board has disbursed more than ₹20 crores in benefits to the families of deceased workers since the inception of the scheme.

The GBOCWWB also conducts awareness programs to inform construction workers about their rights and benefits under the scheme.

These programs are held in various locations across Goa to reach a wider audience.

The Death Benefit scheme is a crucial component of the welfare measures provided to construction workers in Goa.

It reflects the government's commitment to ensuring the safety and well-being of workers in the construction industry.

The scheme is designed to provide immediate financial relief to families who may be facing sudden economic hardships due to the loss of a family member.

In addition to the Death Benefit, the GBOCWWB also offers various other welfare schemes aimed at improving the living conditions of construction workers.

These include schemes for medical assistance, education for children, and housing support.

The GBOCWWB is continuously working to enhance the benefits provided to construction workers and their families.

The board regularly reviews the schemes to ensure they meet the needs of the workers effectively.

The Death Benefit scheme is one of the most significant initiatives aimed at providing support during difficult times.

It is essential for construction workers to be aware of their rights and the benefits available to them under this scheme.

The government encourages all eligible construction workers to register with the GBOCWWB to avail themselves of these benefits.

The registration process is straightforward and can be completed online or at designated offices.

The GBOCWWB is committed to transparency and efficiency in the disbursement of benefits.

The board has implemented measures to streamline the application process and reduce delays.

The Death Benefit scheme is a testament to the government's recognition of the risks associated with construction work.

It aims to provide a safety net for families who depend on the income of construction workers.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme can significantly impact the lives of the beneficiaries.

It helps them cope with the immediate financial challenges following the death of a family member.

The GBOCWWB continues to promote the scheme through various outreach initiatives.

These efforts aim to ensure that all eligible workers are informed about the benefits available to them.

The board regularly updates its policies and procedures to enhance the welfare of construction workers in Goa.

The Death Benefit scheme is an integral part of the overall strategy to support the construction workforce in the state.

It underscores the importance of social security measures for workers in high-risk occupations.

The GBOCWWB remains dedicated to improving the lives of construction workers and their families through this and other welfare initiatives.
